note: Every public source found for com.instagram.barcelona, with the branches and commits it was last read at, its licence and what HushThreads may take from it. scripts/threads-sources.ps1 holds it to its rules, scripts/audit-threads-sources.ps1 refreshes it, and a local release needs a census from the last 14 days. License URLs and any adoption or provenance pins are independent of those watched-path commits.

entries.reason: The first Threads patch anyone published: Hide ads through the same meta/ads fingerprint ReVanced uses for Instagram, which shows the two apps share their ad code. It's pinned to 382 and its anchor string, SponsoredContentController.insertItem, is gone from 449. Ancestry and shared-code evidence, no code to port.

entries.reason: Where the Threads ads lineage starts (2026-06-19). Its filter keys on obfuscated Media methods and a boolean method of BarcelonaSpoolFeedCacheHandler that 449 no longer has, and its own issues #5 and #16 report the filter broken. Kept for ancestry and for the feature list.

Found the place HushThreads takes ads out, the feed cache's merge of a fetched page, found by its shape and the Kotlin lambda it builds. That anchor is unique on 449 and HushThreads credits it. Its extension reflects on obfuscated names written down per build (DED, DGK, A05, A02 and more), so none of its code is taken. Its Open links externally (21c07f40cf, 2026-10-02) hooks the named WebLinkUseCase and returns Unit after a launch; HushThreads' own Open links in browser already covers it, so nothing is taken from it either.

A custom share domain for Threads links. CopyToClipboardUseCase$copyLink$result$1 still exists on 449, but its chat invite string sits in five methods, so the anchor is ambiguous there. A candidate for a later share domain patch. HushThreads cleans the link where the server's permalink is parsed instead.
Its two Threads patches are names without working bodies. Its Instagram set belongs to HushGram's ledger.

An Xposed module that discovers Threads ad hooks with DexKit and records its findings in HOOK_NOTES.md. The inspected 2.0.0 source uses the modern Xposed API 102, with model, Pando and rendered-label filtering and a compiled Brainfuck policy. Its current compatibility table reports Threads 448.0.0.54.85. Kept as an independent source of ad-anchor evidence. No code has been adopted.

GPL-3.0 patch source explicitly targets Threads and Instagram. Hide Ads returns false from the private Boolean method matched by SponsoredContentController.insertItem. No exact Threads versions are declared. GitHub records generation from the ReVanced patch template. No code has been adopted and no current fixture compatibility has been verified.

No code has been adopted or fixture compatibility verified.

Their blobs differ, so this is a separate source entry. The comparison proves those files only, not whole-repository identity. No exact Threads builds are declared, and no code has been adopted.
